question: 'STAUNCH' is related to 'WXEYRGL' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way. 'BLISS' is related to 'FPMWW'. To which of the following is 'COWARD' related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: (4) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

'STAUNCH' is related to 'WXEYRGL'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336f108ecf85405a599b6fcc53025dad525104f9f08f91857ec85420dec3005e.png] 

​And,

'BLISS' is related to 'FPMWW'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed3da91fb65df55f5ac6ed07761edf7f83b2269a056f58e7c02edf0c874196d3.png] 

​Similarly,

'COWARD' is related to

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02dcbb6df633a8ecca7496b63cb4e3e2d7e8a097e552db96198f7b85550ca6fd.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
